result.summary: The pedestrian environment features sidewalks and street lighting but lacks clearly marked crosswalks and visible pedestrian signals at a complex intersection with tram tracks. The roadway surface is significantly degraded with uneven pavement and potholes, posing tripping hazards for those crossing. While the presence of trees and buildings creates a defined streetscape, the lack of dedicated crossing infrastructure increases exposure to vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Tram tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tram tracks create a tripping hazard and can be slippery for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection and roadway.

hazards.name: Poor pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt with potholes near the tracks increases the risk of falls.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: The absence of painted crosswalks fails to provide a designated path for pedestrians or a visual cue for drivers.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Pavement rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair the degraded roadway surface and level the area around the tram tracks.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is currently compromised by active construction that obstructs the sidewalk and forces pedestrians toward the roadway. The presence of embedded tracks and uneven cobblestone pavement creates significant trip hazards and accessibility challenges, while the lack of marked crosswalks at the intersection increases exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Construction Obstruction
hazards.description: Fencing and construction materials on the left side of the image completely block the sidewalk, likely forcing pedestrians into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground and midground along the new building

hazards.name: Embedded Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks embedded in the roadway create a significant trip hazard and can be slippery for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: The transition between cobblestones, asphalt, and tracks creates an uneven surface that is difficult for those with mobility aids or strollers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way at the intersection.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Access Route
interventions.description: Implement a protected, ADA-compliant walkway around the construction site to keep pedestrians out of the vehicle travel lanes.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a paved sidewalk and a cobblestone roadway in a commercial district. While traffic signals and pedestrian signals are present, the sidewalk is narrowed by various obstructions like mailboxes and trash cans, and there are no visible marked crosswalks at the intersection.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Mailbox, trash cans, and utility poles reduce the usable width of the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalk
hazards.description: No painted crosswalk is visible at the signalized intersection, reducing pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly delineate pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clear Zone
interventions.description: Relocate street furniture to maintain a clear, unobstructed path for pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a commercial street with a cobblestone roadway and mature trees that provide natural traffic calming. However, the environment lacks marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and accessible curb ramps, while the uneven road surface presents a potential trip hazard.

hazards.name: Uneven Road Surface
hazards.description: The cobblestone roadway is inherently uneven, creating trip hazards and difficulties for people with mobility aids or strollers.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Despite the presence of a traffic signal, there are no marked crosswalks to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to crossing locations.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the middle ground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks using materials compatible with the historic character to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the corners to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signal heads to the existing traffic light infrastructure to provide clear crossing intervals.
